positions.name: RememberAsyncJobContract
positions.frame: What did ratifying the async job contract for remember settle — what it returns, what it guarantees, and how the result is retrieved?
positions.why: All three expressions are the same speaker's settled, present-tense description of one ratified mechanism: src-1 states the return (receipt, seconds, cursor-poll), src-2 states its negative guarantees (no blocking, no lost work), src-3 states the retrieval paths (poll or piggyback). Conviction and register readings mark src-1 and src-2 as decision-grade (ratification, unhedged invariant) while src-3 sits closer to plain descriptive claim — a mild gradient, but all three cohere as facets of the same ratified contract rather than separable stances, so they group under one frame rather than three.
